text: America declining is progress, right? And you have to say that in a way, competition between China and the US as China rises and America decays is also progress. You have to say that war and conflict and the lions fighting each other over who gets to eat the gazelle is progress. You have to say that the lion eating the gazelle is progress. You have to say the lion dying is progress. You have to say all of these things are progress. Otherwise, your model doesn't work. You can't argue progress in this reductionistic way. I think the best way it can be argued is that in the future there are more complexities that lead to even more complexities arising. And during this process, more and more sophisticated dynamics also start to emerge and create further emergence that leads to us. So we are not just our life.
